method: Read-only static code audit of the current full-base tree by five parallel reviewers; every file:line re-checked to exist; no tests executed, no app, SQL or provider HTTP.

state_definitions.done: provider call or local effect implemented, reachable from normal API/UI/worker, with a local fake/fixture/contract test for the operation
state_definitions.partial: some code exists but a route/UI/worker callsite, test, half of the operation or registry declaration is missing, or the transport is disabled
state_definitions.needs_account: sandbox/account acceptance needs a provider account, key or agreement not available locally (czeka na dostawcę)

boundary: Code-level state only. Nothing here is local, sandbox or account acceptance; scope v6 statuses are unchanged.
